main_text.head: SERENISSIMO ET POTENTISSIMO PRINCIPI, DOMINO FRIDERICO WILHELMO, MARCHIONI Brandenburgico, Sacri Romani Imperii ARCHICAMERARIO, & Principi ELECTORI; Prussiæ, Magdeburgi, Juliaci, Clviæ, Montium, Stetini, Pomeraniæ, Cassubiorum Vandalorúmque, nec non in Silesia Crosnæ & Suibusiæ DUCI; Norinbergensi BURGGRAVIO; Halberstadii, Mindæ & Camini PRINCIPI; Marcæ, Hohenzolleræ,& Ravensbergi COMITI; DOMINO in Ravensperg, Lauenburg, & Bütau;
DOMINO MEO CLEMENTISSIMO.
main_text.p: Difficilima & deploratissima sunt, in quorum maturitatem Deus, justo equidem sanctóque, sed paterno eodem erga domum & familiam suam judicio usus,

page.notes: The large red initial "D" is joined to "ifficilima" as "Difficilima". Red display lines are the title; the black capitals and italic lines are part of the same heading block. The page is slightly stained; no legible printed words were lost.
